Bei der Kontonutzung verarbeiten wir die: When you use an account, we process your login identifier and profile details such as name, city, email and optional phone number. We also process listings, uploaded photos, favourites and booking data including dates, status and saved prices. External services may receive technical connection data, in particular your IP address.
Die Daten werden zur Anmeldung, Profilve: Data is needed for sign-in, profile management, publishing listings, saving favourites and processing rental requests. Before publication, the responsible operator must establish the applicable legal bases under Article 6 GDPR and any legitimate interests.
Für die Anmeldung wird Clerk eingesetzt,: Clerk is used for authentication and Cloudinary for listing photos. Profile, listing and booking data is stored in PostgreSQL. The actual contractors, hosting providers, storage locations and processing agreements must be documented before public operation.
Öffentliche Anzeigen zeigen unter andere: Public listings show photos, descriptions, city and public owner details. Booking data is accessible to the participants concerned. Do not upload photos showing uninvolved people or confidential information.
Die Anwendung speichert die gewählte Dar: The app stores your chosen appearance locally in the browser. Clerk sign-in may use cookies and other session information. The list, retention periods and assessment of browser storage must be completed before publication.
Verbindliche Löschfristen und Aufbewahru: Binding deletion periods and retention criteria are yet to be established. Hiding a listing does not delete it or its booking history. Permanent deletion through the app is only intended for listings without bookings.
Nach Maßgabe der DSGVO bestehen insbeson: Under the GDPR, rights include access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection. Contact details for exercising these rights and the competent authority are yet to be added.
